subject.title: fix(launcher): stop respawned children after parent death on Unix

question: Should maintainers require exact Linux systemd/root-owned restart proof before merging this parent-death guard, or accept targeted launcher SIGKILL proof after the branch refresh?
rationale: The code path is source-reproducible and the contributor supplied terminal proof, but the linked user report involved systemd restart behavior that was not fully exercised on this head.

options.title: Refresh and land with focused proof
options.body: Resolve the current-main conflict, rerun launcher/process checks, and land if the parent marker remains consumed and Unix children exit only after parent death.

options.title: Require systemd proof first
options.body: Ask for a live Ubuntu systemd/root-owned gateway restart transcript before merge to cover the exact reported service scenario.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Keep the fix unmerged until a maintainer decides whether this lifecycle behavior should be handled differently.
